messages:
Alex M: quick question — customer gave us request_id=abc12345 and says nothing shows up in the console. Where do I look first?
Maya R: start with the Console -> Requests page, paste the request_id into the top-level search. set time window +/- 5m from the customer timestamp. usually shows up as a request row with a trace link.
Alex M: I tried that, nothing. CLI option?
Sasha P: yep, CLI is faster for deeper hunts. run: `ri logs find --request-id abc12345 --env prod --from "2026-03-10T14:00:00Z" --to "2026-03-10T14:10:00Z"`
Sasha P: if you just want a compact one-liner to grep across raw logs (S3 or local), use: `ri logs export --request-id abc12345 | grep "request_id=abc12345" -A2 -B2`
Devon L: example raw log line I usually see: `2026-03-10T14:03:21.412Z [info] req=abc12345 route=/v1/generate latency=123ms trace=4f8a9c2b`
Maya R: if you have the trace id from a span (e.g., 4f8a9c2b) you can open Console -> Traces, paste trace id, then open the span and click the "open logs" link which surfaces the exact log lines and request_id.
Alex M: ops-bot, can you check retention/archive for that timeframe?
ops-bot: Found logs for 2026-03-10 14:00-14:10 in archived bucket `redwood-logs-prod-archive`. Suggest `ri logs fetch-archive --bucket redwood-logs-prod-archive --key prefix/2026/03/10/14/ --filter "request_id=abc12345"`
Alex M: that helped — got one hit in archived files. it's the service that forwarded to a downstream job, so the request_id shows up in the worker logs, not gateway.
Sasha P: tip — console search sometimes misses archived/older shards. If CLI `ri logs find` returns nothing, try `ri traces find --request-id abc12345` to see if any span had the id and then follow trace -> logs.
Maya R: also check the customer-provided timestamp timezone. a lot of misses are just TZ mismatch.
Devon L: if you want a short checklist to copy into an incident note: 1) Console Requests search -> id + time window. 2) `ri logs find --request-id`. 3) `ri traces find --request-id` -> open trace. 4) `ri logs export | grep` or `ri logs fetch-archive` if older. 5) check worker/downstream service logs.
Alex M: thanks all — will follow up in the ticket with the archived log snippet. :thumbsup:
